text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with 
Marvelous Sunday, we ran into Ikuno 
Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo, Ikuno! What're you up to?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Marvelous-san. There was an old piece 
of paper tucked inside a secondhand book I 
bought, and I've been wondering whether 
it's okay to throw it away...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there are so many ancient 
characters!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Letters... I see. Now that you mention it, 
there is a pattern.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
This looks like a constellation, and this 
one represents coordinates, it seems☆ 
Though it cuts off halfway through, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: At times like this, what do you do~~??

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"A romantic, historic discovery!" And 
done! Now that is marvelous☆

Marvelous Sunday's future-predicting 
diary. My heart pounded with excitement 
wondering what kind of miracle she'd make 
happen this time as I followed her—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous-san, why are you at the club?! 
What does this have to do with that 
paper...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay! Feel the Marvelous☆ And you will 
achieve Marvelousness~~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer, feel it too! Marvelous 
is drawing near~☆★

I still can't comprehend it. Yet, 
something might happen... just like at the 
previous party. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even you, Trainer?! Aaah, the paper's 
crumpling up from the steam—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: !! Th-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the temperature change made it 
show up! It was written in special ink☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, the rest of the coordinates and some 
new letters!! 'TREASURE' 'IS' 'HERE'...!!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... These are the 
coordinates, but...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
All I see are trees. ...But if there are 
trees, then we can just look for the 
Marvelous in the trees!

Marvelous... A great tree rooted for many 
years. A witness that watched over this 
land's history...?

A damaged tree trunk catches my eye. 
...No, that's not damage. There's some 
kind of faint pattern on it—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
!! ...You saw it too, didn't you, 
Trainer?☆ Let's go, both of you!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my... This rock? Is there some sort of 
pattern on it...?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ancient writing! Let's see... "The 
treasure is a lie. Good job!" What?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha, ahahahahaha! I totally fell for an 
ancient prank~~!
choice_data_list:
Hahaha! I've been completely fooled, 
huh...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Good grief... Quite the magnificent 
prank. However—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's so refreshing to have the mystery 
solved. Even if by coincidence, we were 
lucky to find that club and that tree.

Is that really true? Leading up to our 
arrival here, I felt almost as if 
something were guiding us...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Nope, the result was inevitable! Just by 
believing strongly and sharpening your 
senses, your antenna will naturally turn 
in the right direction☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"A diary is merely a catalyst. What truly 
matters is following the Marvelous in your 
heart—"

By writing it down in a diary, one becomes 
consciously aware of trying to achieve it. 
This was the true identity of the power 
that made dreams come true.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ????? In other words, what does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! MARVELOUUUUS!!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm only getting more and more 
confused!?
choice_data_list: It's hard to explain in words...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm only getting more and more 
confused!?
choice_data_list: It's hard to explain in words...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... How about we start by 
believing in Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then, even the faintest Marvelous begins 
to take shape, showing you the path ahead!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I feel like I get it, but I really 
don't...! *cries*

“Indeed, one cannot understand without 
realizing it. Yet if one understands, they 
could even grasp happiness.”

I want to share this Marvelousness with 
everyone. Before I knew it, that had 
become my wish...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Marvelous is free! It's 
ever-changing, and entirely up to you!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's a reflection on Ikuno's 
lenses! Maybe Marvelous is over that way!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please wait! Let me explain one more 
time~!

First, realizing it is key. Once you 
understand this, even happiness is within 
reach.

I want to share this Marvelousness with 
everyone. Before I knew it, that had 
become my wish...
